title: Super Slaw
ingredients: DRESSING: 2 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1 tbsp fat-free Greek yogurt, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1/2 tsp honey, salt and pepper
method: In a large bowl, combine the white and red cabbage, carrots and spring onions.
In a small bowl, mix together all the dressing ingredients and season well.
Pour the dressing over the slaw and mix everything together thoroughly.
Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 2 days.
notes: Great alongside pulled pork, doner kebab and as a burger topping. Try adding finely chopped apple or fennel for extra flavour.
